bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4b06a39ebdb8a99d5544b27c8a52f33ad8e42440"
p=server/tests/server-command-tool-runtime.test.cjs
test "$(git ls-files --stage -- "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 100644
test "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = bcf4e7766c4183549a542016e107608749716d19dc7256b3070b5d38b75b454a
test "$(git hash-object "$p")" = "$(git rev-parse "HEAD:$p")"
test ! -L "$p"
chmod 0644 "$p"
test "$(stat -c %a "$p")" = 644
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
printf 'HOST_PUBLIC_TEST_MODE=644\nTRACKED_CONTENT_UNCHANGED=PASS\n'
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json
c=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","debug-ai-debug-ai-1","node","-e","const fs=require('node:fs'); const d='/app/runtime/durable/run-state-v2';const rows=fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json')).map(x=>{try{return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(d+'/'+x,'utf8'))}catch{return {status:'UNREADABLE'}}}):[];console.log(JSON.stringify(rows.map(x=>({id:x.run_id||x.id||null,status:x.status||x.state||null}))))"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
rows=json.loads(c.stdout); print("DURABLE_STATE_COUNTS="+json.dumps({str(k):sum(x['status']==k for x in rows) for k in set(x['status'] for x in rows)}))
PY
